routine: 단어 5분(예문 소리 내어 2번) → 패턴 5분(뼈대에 내 문장 넣기) → 위를 가리고 문제 3분 → 복습 2분 → 오늘 쓸 표현 1개 골라 실제 메일에 쓰기

review.title: 복습 (11/18·11/16·11/11 표현 + 오답 2개), 영어로 먼저 써 보기

items.prompt: 신입 직원 적응 교육 — training for new staff 대신
잘 안 쓰이는, 활용이 적은 — used less 대신
(다른 자료와) 대조해 확인하다: ____ A against B

items.answer: My understanding is that ~. Please correct me if I'm wrong.
Depending on ~, we will decide whether to ~.
We were not aware that ~ until ~.
I would like to bring ~ to your attention.
Please ~ in the same way as ~.

items.prompt: 명확히 하다, 분명히 설명하다 — explain clearly 대신

cover_practice.prompt: 수치로 나타내다: Please q_______ the overtime hours by line in your weekly report.
항목별로 나누어 적다: Please i_______ the repair costs: parts, labor and travel.
용량이 작은: The water tank is u_________ for the number of workers we have now.
하나로 모으다: Please c__________ the four sample invoices into one file before you send it to HQ.
앞으로 신입 직원은 첫 주에 매일 업무보고를 보내는 것을 규칙으로 합시다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: From now on, let's make it a rule that new staff send a daily report in their first week.

cover_practice.prompt: 모든 PR은 견적 2개가 필요합니다. 유일한 예외는 긴급 수리이며, 견적 1개로 진행할 수 있습니다. (주어·동사 넣기)
cover_practice.answer: All PRs need two quotations. The only exception is urgent repairs, which can go ahead with one quotation.

words.example: Please quantify each task in your daily report: how many rolls and yards you checked.
words.collocations: quantify the work / quantify the impact

words.meaning: 항목별로 나누어 적다 — show separately 대신
words.example: Please ask the suppliers to itemize the pump and installation costs.
words.collocations: an itemized quotation / itemize the costs

words.example: The inspector said our boiler feed pump is undersized.

words.meaning: (여러 건을) 하나로 모으다 — collect together 대신
words.example: The clinic will consolidate the month's medical costs and bill us once.
words.collocations: consolidate the invoices / a consolidated bill

patterns.pattern: From now on, let's make it a rule that ~.
patterns.meaning: 앞으로 ~하는 것을 규칙으로 합시다 (From now on, please ~ 대신, 팀 전체 기준을 정할 때)
patterns.skeleton: let's make it a rule that + [주어] + [동사]
patterns.email: From now on, let's make it a rule that the two loading documents go to the Shipping team within 2 days.

patterns.pattern: Apart from ~, is there anything else (that) ~?
patterns.meaning: ~ 외에 ~한 것이 더 있나요? (Is there more? 대신, 빠진 것이 없는지 확인할 때)
patterns.skeleton: Apart from + [명사], is there anything else that + [동사]?
patterns.email: Apart from this list, is there anything else that was sent under our tax code?

patterns.meaning: 유일한 예외는 ~이며, ~합니다 (But ~ is different 대신, 규칙의 예외를 짚을 때)
patterns.email: The only exception is accidents after 6 PM, which must go to another hospital.
patterns.spoken: Except after 6 PM. Then we go to the hospital.

source: 11/18 보낸 메일(신입 일일보고, 펌프 교체 견적 요청, 보험 갱신, 치료비 정산 방식, 신고 누락 확인, 선적 서류 규칙)에서 고름.
